ad_library.summary: 1 live Meta ad confirmed on 2026-11-21 by opening library ID 1122485234026419 directly on the Envious Energy Private Limited page (page ID 1051756784689440). It is the only ad running: the page's own ad listing returns exactly 1 active ad. The creative sells residential and commercial rooftop solar with government subsidy assistance and clicks to WhatsApp, not to the website. The website was read live the same day. Google Ads Transparency records were not checked in this pass.

funnel.meaning: The only live ad clicks straight to a WhatsApp chat. The enquiry never reaches enviousenergy.com, so the site cannot measure, retarget or attribute any of this spend, and a brand with 13 years of project history gets no retargeting audience from it.

findings: The single live ad clicks to WhatsApp, not to enviousenergy.com - the enquiry never reaches the website, so the spend cannot be measured, retargeted or attributed.

The social-proof numbers on the home page are placeholders or incoherent: 'Solar Installations 304+', 'Energy Generated 32MW+', 'Solar System Lifespan 1+', 'Solar Powered Homes 24+', 'Trees 4K+', 'Commitment to Clean 4%', and a 'Years Of Experience 0+' counter. 'Commitment to Clean 4%' and a 1+ year system lifespan are not things a buyer can believe.
The review widget on the home page renders '0.2/5' directly above 'Over 500 + Reviews'. A 0.2 rating printed on the page does more damage than showing no rating at all.

Two template team members are still published: /our-team/marvin-mckinney/ and /our-team/kathryn-murphy/ carry stock bios ('Marvin McKinney ... over a decade of experience ... Leslie leads complex projects', with the wrong name in the bio) and skill bars set to 1%.

The company has three different addresses across its own channels: the contact page says 1-8-619 (29/2RT) Sai Arcade, Prakash Nagar, Begumpet, Hyderabad-500016; the footer says #1-10-75/1/1 to 6, Unit 608, Saptagiri Towers, Begumpet, Hyderabad-500016; TGREDCO lists H.No 35-69, GK Colony, Sainikpuri Post, Secunderabad-500094.

Two support phone numbers are in circulation on the same site (+91-89777 21950 in the header and footer) against the TGREDCO empanelled contact of 9000377655, and the footer email link points at 'mailto:info@domainname.com' instead of the real address.
The home page has no contact form - the enquiry form only exists on /contact-us/ - so a visitor who is ready to enquire on the landing page has nowhere to type.
Every H1 and section heading is rendered with letter-spacing ('U t i l i z e   S o l a r   E n e r g y'), which reads as broken text to a screen reader and to Google.

Ad copy promises 'Government Subsidy Assistance*' with an asterisk, but the ad card never carries the qualifying footnote and the site buries the Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar figure inside an FAQ accordion rather than on the landing path.
next_steps: Point the ad at the website, not just WhatsApp
Add a website destination with a Meta Pixel and UTMs alongside the WhatsApp CTA so the click can be measured and the visitor can be retargeted.
Replace the placeholder counters with real figures

TGREDCO empanelment and 13 years of delivery are stronger proof than '304+' and '4%'. Publish installed kW, project count and the named institutional clients (Gitanjali School, NTR Model School, The Hyderabad Gymkhana) as numbers, not counters.
Fix the rating source or remove the widget until it renders correctly - a 0.2/5 badge next to '500+ reviews' destroys trust at the exact moment of decision.
Delete or replace the stock team pages
Marvin McKinney and Kathryn Murphy are unused template entries with mismatched bios and 1% skill bars. Replace them with the real leadership team or unpublish them.
Settle on one address and one phone number
Pick the empanelled address and the number you actually answer, and use them in the header, the footer, the contact page and the ad account. Fix the 'info@domainname.com' footer link.
Put a form on the landing page
Add the enquiry form to the home page, directly under the hero, so the visit does not have to survive a second click.

site_audit.scope_note: The website was read live on 2026-11-21 through a rendered-content fetch of the home page, /contact-us/ and one team page. Tracking-pixel and head checks (Meta Pixel, GA4, GTM, Google Ads, meta description, Open Graph, JSON-LD, favicon) need the raw served HTML and were not captured through this channel, so they are recorded as not checked rather than absent. PageSpeed was not run.

issues: No contact form on homepage — visitors can't easily enquire
No live chat — missing after-hours leads

site_evidence.note: Head HTML not captured through the sandbox fetch channel; pixel presence is not checked, not asserted absent. No UTM parameters appear on any link found in the rendered page content.

promise_gap.promise: 'Government Subsidy Assistance*' - the asterisk has no footnote on the ad
promise_gap.site: The Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar figure appears only inside an FAQ accordion on the home page, not on the hero or the CTA path. There is no subsidy page and no eligibility calculator.

No panel brand, wattage class, warranty term or certification is named on the home page. The named clients and the 110-120 kW school installs sit in a testimonial carousel rather than a case-study the buyer can check.
No support SLA, AMC plan, response time or service-area map is published. The only support surface is a WhatsApp widget.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
